prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of Rust — the lord of the Rust House of the Oxygen Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a clear adult face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a provocative, teasing boldness — a challenging, half-lidded stare and a knowing closed-lip smile; olive skin; heart-shaped face; eyes of natural size — almond-shaped eyes of natural size, outer eye corners slightly lifted; brows with a clean, angled peak; a nose with a gentle aquiline curve; medium-full lips of natural width; coral-orange eyes; dark berry lipstick.
Body and hair: voluptuous, generously curved at bust, hips and thighs build; a very long tail bound at intervals by hair rings with choppy uneven bangs; rust-streaked dark brown-black hair.
Expression: a cool, knowing look.
Her element, carried in her design: breath and fire and rust in one: cool clear air as translucent cloth, bright combustion orange as accents, the quiet power to corrode, the deep blue of oceans and the green of forests; it is the element of life and burning.
Her house, carried in her design: oxidation as an active, creeping force: salt wind and rain eating into iron, red ochre earth, the red dust of Mars — bloom-like orange-red patina spreading over blue-grey metal, flaking edges, mineral reds and browns; the hungry, transforming side of oxygen.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. White and sea-blue armor with clear visor panels, bubble-shaped pauldrons, tank-and-valve motifs, combustion-orange glow lines, a back unit of two rounded tanks.
Silhouette: a large equipment unit worn on the back (tanks, a cannon barrel or antennae) rising above her head as the main shape, with medium body armor. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: sea blue, forest green, clear white, combustion orange.
House colours: ochre red, iron-oxide orange, sea-salt white, weathered blue-grey.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, an ocean terraforming station: oxygen-generation towers venting white plumes, coral-glass domes, blue-green plasma light.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (O) and atomic number (8) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
